author: Ellie Hook
title: C-SPAN interrupted after 'completely unaware' Trump suffers embarrassing live blunder - NewsBreak
text:
By Ellie Hook ,
2 hours ago
Donald Trump has reignited health concerns following his appearance at the G7 summit in France.
The president , who marked his 80th birthday on Sunday, appeared disoriented during a photoshoot at the summit, seemingly unaware that a photograph was being taken.
The summit has been marked by several uncomfortable moments for Trump, who earlier that day appeared to wander off in the wrong direction. In that instance, Trump walked to his right after posing for a photograph, while the other politicians in attendance remained in place. It comes after Donald Trump was left 'furious' over Situation Room leaks .
French President Emmanuel Macron then seemed to guide him back to the correct position. Trump also drew criticism for what was described as a "creepy" and "totally inappropriate" move involving French President Emmanuel Macron's wife.
In yet another peculiar incident, broadcast live on C-SPAN, Trump seemed entirely oblivious that an aerial photograph was being taken of himself and the other world leaders at the event, despite Macron prompting everyone to pose for it, reports The Mirror .
Trump at the G7 Summit Trump, who was sitting at a conference table, did not look at the camera or even seem to realize it was happening. The photograph was subsequently posted by the French government on social media with the caption "Bienvenue à Évian!" (Welcome to Evian!).
A video clip of the incident has circulated widely on X, where one observer noted, "Embarrassing moment for Trump, who is the only one completely oblivious to a group photo being taken. An unintentionally perfect snapshot of his presidency."
Another user remarked, "HE'S DONE IT! ! ! He's figured out how to sleep with his eyes open! ! !" while a third commented, "It's like he's sleeping with his eyes open. Completely unaware."
The Democrats' Headquarters account also weighed in, posting, "Trump, 80, seems unaware that everyone else is posing for a photo."
Additional commentary included, "It's like he's sleeping with his eyes open. Completely unaware," with another viewer observing, "He's completely unengaged."
One user expressed concern, "I wonder if, in addition to all his other problems, he's dealing with major, maybe even psychotic, depression. SOMEONE NEEDS TO LOOK AFTER THIS MAN MEDICALLY AND REMOVE HIM FROM THE OFFICE. HE'S NOT UP TO THIS, HE NEVER WAS,".
The awkward moment occurred during an unusual aerial photograph at the G7 summit in France, where world leaders gathered in Évian-les-Bains this week. The forum is addressing critical matters including the conflicts in Iran and Ukraine, alongside pressing international concerns ranging from the global economy to artificial intelligence.
The Group of Seven comprises leaders from France's Macron, Germany's Friedrich Merz, Japan's Sanae Takaichi, Italy's Giorgia Meloni, Britain's Sir Keir Starmer, and Canada's Mark Carney. This development follows reports suggesting Trump may dismiss Pete Hegseth following a significant confrontation with the Secretary of War.
